question: Met a guy at the trade show this morning who wants a quote. How do I add him as a new client in here?

articles.title: Add a contact
articles.body:
Contacts are the people you do business with.

1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Select **New contact**.
3. Enter a **First name**. All other fields are optional.
4. Optionally add a **Last name**, **Email**, **Phone**, **Job title**, **Company** and **Status**.
5. Select **Save contact**.

The new contact opens straight away so you can add notes or deals.
